note: The conformal coverage guarantee is marginal and distribution-free under exchangeability of calibration and test examples. It is NOT class-conditional, NOT a per-case correctness guarantee, and NOT an abstention-rate guarantee. Selective accuracy is the fraction of singleton predictions that are correct. A small test set does not formally verify the guarantee; divergence between empirical and target coverage suggests exchangeability may not hold for that group.
